name: Dhruva Capital Services Limited
about: Dhruva Capital Services Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the business of investment and financing in India. The company offers business and CV/CE loans, invoice discounting, loans against properties for businesses, lease rental discounting, and construction finance products. It also provides EV/CV, gold, personal, and home loans, as well as loans against properties for individuals. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Kolkata, India.
